text:
Heather was the absolute BEST!! Her attention to detail blew our mind. Not only
was our painting an excellent rendition of the photo she captured, but she even captured the time in my husband’s watch, of when we actually said “I Do”.  Real feathers and beads are in the painting and with our wedding being on a yacht, she used actual water from the dock, for her paint. Every single guest was blown away by this surprise and my husband was, as well. It fits so beautifully in our home!! Definitely my favorite takeaway from Our Big Day.

owner_reply.text: Ciera your wedding was unbelievably gorgeous and I had such a wonderful time painting the night away as we cruise by the Miami skyline. I must say that was a first for me! I will always remember this special painting and how much fun I had! Thank you for letting me be apart of you wedding and encouraged me to let my creative mind flow without limitations. This painting is one of my favorites!!
